client.business_model: Family-founded specialty e-commerce and catalog retailer/wholesaler of Christian books, Bibles, homeschool and gift products, fulfilling orders from a single headquarters & distribution center.
client.client_history: Founded in 1978 in Massachusetts as Christian Book Distributors by Stephen Hendrickson, the company rebranded to Christianbook in 2019 to avoid CBD confusion and has grown into a leading global supplier of faith-based books and resources. In 2021 it completed a recapitalization with Nonantum Capital Partners to accelerate growth.

revenue.source: Accio.com company profile (est. $53.4M, accessed 2024-07); Manta.com profile reports $71.1M
revenue.notes: Only third-party estimation sites available and figures vary ($53.4M Accio vs $71.1M Manta vs $25-100M SignalHire). Using Accio midpoint but reliability is low.

locations.source: Christianbook.com About Us page – describes single 370,000-sq-ft headquarters/distribution facility at 140 Summit St., Peabody, MA
locations.notes: No evidence of additional retail sites; company operates primarily online/phone order fulfillment from Peabody campus.

employees.source: Christianbook.com About Us page ("employs approximately 600 individuals"); corroborated by Itemlive.com article (2020) stating "close to 600 people"
employees.notes: No newer LinkedIn headcount found; two independent sources align on ~600.
